_comment: Reviewed registry for tests/test_erasure_coverage.py (#856). Every table the Worker migrations create is listed with its exact column list, a class and a reason. A new table or column fails the test until it is added here on purpose, with review. classes: lead = rows that hold an address or carry a lead id, removed by `reach-around leads delete` (its SQL must delete the table and its read-back must count it); lead_hash = a keyed hash of an event that can include an address, short-lived, cleared by hand (docs/privacy.md); unlinkable = visitor rows with no address, no IP address and no lead id, so a request cannot be matched to them (Art. 11), bounded by retention; aggregate = counts, labels and bookkeeping with no row per person; internal = SQLite's own table. reviewed_columns: a column whose name looks personal (the test's PERSON_NAME pattern) in a table that is not class lead, each with the reason it holds no personal data. backup: whether scripts/backup-d1.sh exports the table (never or exported); only checked for classes lead, lead_hash and unlinkable.

leads.reason: One row per address typed into the kit gate. Removed by the delete tool (id and address paired). Also purged by age (worker/src/kit/leadretention.ts).

kit_events.reason: Hour-rounded unlock, view and verify events keyed by lead_id. Removed by the delete tool; the foreign key cascades as a second layer.

alert_dedup.reason: HMAC of site, event kind and the event identity (an address, or the inquiry fields) under a secret key; held at most 10 minutes (expires_at) and pruned on the next alert write. Cannot be matched to an address without the key. Cleared by hand with the statement in docs/privacy.md.

visitor_seen.reason: Daily keyed hash of the connection address with no other column; deleted after its day. Holds no lead id and no address, so it cannot be joined to a lead.

reviewed_columns.h: keyed daily hash of the connection address, own table, no join key; removed within about an hour of the day ending

view_events.reason: Raw page view rows: coarse categories only, no address, user agent string, referrer URL or lead id. Retention purge removes them.

reviewed_columns.src_kind: closed one-letter source kind (direct, internal, referrer host, utm label, other)
reviewed_columns.src: referrer host or campaign label, not a URL
reviewed_columns.country: two-letter country code from the edge
reviewed_columns.region: coarse region name, default geo level
reviewed_columns.city: empty unless GEO_LEVEL=city; never joined to a person

click_events.reason: One row per accepted click: hour-rounded time, link id, source label. No address, user agent or referrer. Retention purge removes them.

reviewed_columns.country: two-letter country code; the Worker no longer writes it (migration 0010) and old rows age out
reviewed_columns.src: closed source label, never a URL or an address

alert_quota.reason: Per-minute and per-day alert counters by site and channel; no content.

analytics_coverage.reason: 24 letters per day saying whether collection ran.

click_budget_lh.reason: Hourly landing and hop write budget counters.

reviewed_columns.country: country code in an aggregate count
country code in an aggregate count

click_src_daily.reason: Daily click counts by source label.

reviewed_columns.src: closed source label in an aggregate count

click_src_monthly.reason: Monthly click counts by source label.

reviewed_columns.src: closed source label in an aggregate count

counters.reason: Route budgets and daily or hourly counters keyed by a short slug. Counts of gate events cannot be un-counted and are not personal data about one person.

kit_meta.reason: Heartbeats and the unstored session floor: one integer per slug, no person.

view_city_daily.reason: Daily view counts by city, only at GEO_LEVEL=city.

reviewed_columns.country: country code in an aggregate count
reviewed_columns.region: region name in an aggregate count
reviewed_columns.city: city name in an aggregate count, purged on its own window

view_daily.reason: Daily view counts by page and source.

reviewed_columns.src: source label in an aggregate count
reviewed_columns.country: country code in an aggregate count

view_dim_daily.reason: Daily view counts by one coarse dimension.

reviewed_columns.country: country code in an aggregate count
reviewed_columns.region: region name in an aggregate count
reviewed_columns.city: city name in an aggregate count

view_meta.reason: Small key and value state: cursors, budgets, health flags. Never request data.

view_rollup_log.reason: Rollup bookkeeping per site and day.

sqlite_sequence.reason: SQLite's own autoincrement bookkeeping: table names and counters.

runtime_stores._comment: Non-D1 places the Worker can write, found by scanning worker/src and worker/wrangler.toml. A new one fails the test until it is listed here with the reason it holds no lead data.

worker/src/live.ts.put(: live poller token cache and state in LIVE_KV, plus the edge cache of the public status body: platform tokens and stream state, no visitor data
worker/src/live.ts.caches.default: edge cache of the public live status body, no visitor data

worker/src/kit/env.ts.KVNamespace: type of the KIT binding; the Worker only reads the gated page from it (key kit/v1) and never writes it
